stem: The number of sightings of a golden eagle at a certain location has a Poisson distribution with mean 2.5 per week. Drilling for oil is started nearby. A naturalist wishes to test at the 5% significance level whether there are fewer sightings since the drilling began. He notes that during the following 3 weeks there are 2 sightings.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the critical region for the test and carry out the test.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: State why the naturalist could not have made a Type II error.
